1332 function sanitizeRatingsSchema(data, hostName = "Host", guestName = "Participant", guestSpoke = false, linguisticMetrics = {}) {
1333   const clamp = (val) => {
1334     const num = parseInt(val, 10);
1335     if (isNaN(num)) return 1;
1336     return Math.max(1, Math.min(10, num));
1337   };
1338 
1339   const ratingsRaw = data?.speakerRatings || data || {};
1340   let hostData = ratingsRaw[hostName] || {};
1341 
1342   if (Object.keys(hostData).length === 0) {
1343     for (const k of Object.keys(ratingsRaw)) {
1344       if (k.toLowerCase() === hostName.toLowerCase() || k.toLowerCase().includes("host") || k === "Speaker 0") {
1345         hostData = ratingsRaw[k];
1346         break;
1347       }
1348     }
1349   }
1350 
1351   const hostLinguistic = linguisticMetrics[hostName] || { words: 0, chars: 0 };
1352   const guestLinguistic = linguisticMetrics[guestName] || { words: 0, chars: 0 };
1353 
1354   const evaluateGuardrail = (speakerData, speakerLinguistic, speakerName) => {
1355     const chars = speakerLinguistic.chars || 0;
1356     const words = speakerLinguistic.words || 0;
1357 
1358     if (chars < 50 || words === 0) {
1359       return {
1360         communication_skills: 1,
1361         fluency: 1,
1362         confidence: 1,
1363         awkwardness: 1,
1364         straightforward_answers: 1,
1365         persuasive_assertiveness: 1,
1366         tone_style: "Polite",
1367         rationale: "Insufficient spoken text for evaluation.",
1368         status_note: "Insufficient spoken text for evaluation.",
1369         is_clamped: true,
1370         word_count: words,
1371         char_count: chars
1372       };
1373     }
1374 
1375     const confScore = clamp(speakerData.confidence);
1376     const rawTone = String(speakerData.tone_style || "").toLowerCase();
1377     const toneStyle = rawTone.includes("command") ? "Commanding" :
1378                       rawTone.includes("request") ? "Requesting" :
1379                       rawTone.includes("polit") ? "Polite" : "Collaborative";
1380 
1381     return {
1382       communication_skills: clamp(speakerData.communication_skills),
1383       fluency: clamp(speakerData.fluency),
1384       confidence: confScore,
1385       awkwardness: clamp(speakerData.awkwardness),
1386       straightforward_answers: clamp(speakerData.straightforward_answers),
1387       persuasive_assertiveness: clamp(speakerData.persuasive_assertiveness || confScore),
1388       tone_style: toneStyle,
1389       rationale: speakerData.rationale || "Verified against transcription evidence.",
1390       status_note: "Validated against transcript",
1391       is_clamped: false,
1392       word_count: words,
1393       char_count: chars
1394     };
1395   };
1396 
1397   const result = {
1398     [hostName]: evaluateGuardrail(hostData, hostLinguistic, hostName)
1399   };
1400 
1401   // Only include guest if guest actually spoke
1402   if (guestSpoke && guestName && guestName.toLowerCase() !== hostName.toLowerCase() && guestLinguistic.words > 0) {
1403     let guestData = ratingsRaw[guestName] || {};
1404     if (Object.keys(guestData).length === 0) {
1405       for (const k of Object.keys(ratingsRaw)) {
1406         if (k.toLowerCase() === guestName.toLowerCase() || k.toLowerCase().includes("participant") || k.toLowerCase().includes("guest") || k === "Speaker 1") {
1407           guestData = ratingsRaw[k];
1408           break;
1409         }
1410       }
1411     }
1412     result[guestName] = evaluateGuardrail(guestData, guestLinguistic, guestName);
1413   }
1414 
1415   return result;
1416 }

1418 /**
1419  * Step 3: HTTPS Callable Cloud Function 'analyzeMeetingRatings'
1420  * 1. Fetches 'rawTranscript' from the Firestore meeting document.
1421  * 2. Uses Google Gemini 1.5 Flash API (@google/generative-ai) secured via defineSecret("GEMINI_API_KEY").
1422  * 3. Evaluates dynamic session speakers independently on the 5 parameters:
1423  *    - Communication Skills
1424  *    - Communication Fluency
1425  *    - Confidence
1426  *    - Awkwardness
1427  *    - Straightforward Answers
1428  * 4. Enforces structured JSON output.
1429  * 5. Saves the evaluation JSON object into the Firestore meeting document under field 'speakerRatings'.
1430  */
1431 exports.analyzeMeetingRatings = onCall(
1432   {
1433     secrets: [geminiApiKey],
1434     memory: "512MiB",
1435     timeoutSeconds: 120,
1436     cors: true
1437   },
1438   async (request) => {
1439     const data = request.data || {};
1440     const meetingId = data.meetingId;
1441     if (!meetingId) {
1442       throw new HttpsError("invalid-argument", "Missing meetingId parameter.");
1443     }
1444 
1445     console.log(`[analyzeMeetingRatings] Scoring speaker ratings for meeting ${meetingId}`);
1446 
1447     // 1. Fetch meeting document from Cloud Firestore to get 'rawTranscript'
1448     const meetingRef = db.collection("meetings").doc(meetingId);
1449     const meetingSnap = await meetingRef.get();
1450 
1451     if (!meetingSnap.exists && !data.rawTranscript) {
1452       throw new HttpsError("not-found", `Meeting document not found at meetings/${meetingId}`);
1453     }
1454 
1455     const meetingData = meetingSnap.exists ? meetingSnap.data() : {};
1456     const rawTranscript = data.rawTranscript || meetingData.rawTranscript;
1457 
1458     let hostName = (data.hostName || meetingData.hostName || "Host").trim();
1459     if (!hostName) hostName = "Host";
1460     let guestName = (Array.isArray(data.participantNames) && data.participantNames[0]) ||
1461       (meetingData.participants && (meetingData.participants[0]?.name || meetingData.participants[0])) ||
1462       (meetingData.participantNames && meetingData.participantNames[0]) ||
1463       "Participant";
1464 
1465     const isSingleTurn = (rawTranscript || "").split("\n").filter((l) => l.trim().length > 0).length <= 1;
1466     const isDummy = (rawTranscript || "").trim() === "Meeting audio session connected and verified." ||
1467                     (rawTranscript || "").includes("Meeting audio session connected and verified.");
1468 
1469     if (!rawTranscript || !rawTranscript.trim() || isSingleTurn || isDummy) {
1470       console.warn(`[analyzeMeetingRatings] Empty, single-turn, or dummy transcript for ${meetingId}. Returning empty evaluation matrix.`);
1471       const ratings = {};
1472       await meetingRef.set(
1473         { speakerRatings: ratings, ratingsStatus: "completed", updatedAt: admin.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp() },
1474         { merge: true }
1475       );
1476       return { success: true, meetingId, speakerRatings: ratings, model: "gemini-1.5-flash" };
1477     }
1478 
1479     // 2. Call Google Gemini 1.5 Flash API
1480     const apiKey = resolveSecret(geminiApiKey, "GEMINI_API_KEY");
1481     if (!apiKey) {
1482       throw new HttpsError("internal", "GEMINI_API_KEY is not configured.");
1483     }
1484     const ratings = await evaluateSpeakerRatingsWithGemini(rawTranscript, hostName, guestName, apiKey);
1485     if (!ratings || Object.keys(ratings).length === 0) {
1486       throw new HttpsError("internal", "Gemini returned an empty payload for speaker ratings.");
1487     }
1488 
1489     // 3. Save evaluation JSON object into Firestore meeting document under field 'speakerRatings'
1490     await meetingRef.set(
1491       {
1492         speakerRatings: ratings,
1493         ratingsStatus: "completed",
1494         updatedAt: admin.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
1495       },
1496       { merge: true }
1497     );
1498 
1499     // Also update transcripts collection for real-time listener sync
1500     try {
1501       await db.collection("transcripts").doc(meetingId).set(
1502         {
1503           speakerRatings: ratings,
1504           updatedAt: admin.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
1505         },
1506         { merge: true }
1507       );
1508     } catch { }
1509 
1510     console.log(`[analyzeMeetingRatings] Successfully saved speakerRatings for meeting ${meetingId}:`, JSON.stringify(ratings));
1511 
1512     // Return success response to client
1513     return {
1514       success: true,
1515       meetingId,
1516       speakerRatings: ratings,
1517       model: "gemini-1.5-flash"
1518     };
1519   }
1520 );

1526 /**
1527  * Step 4: Helper to perform Fact-Checking analysis via Google Gemini 1.5 Flash API
1528  * Performs verbatim string lookup from text dialogue.

1530 async function auditFactCheckWithGemini(rawTranscript, hostName = "Host", guestName = "Participant", apiKey) {
1531   if (apiKey) {
1532     try {
1533       const genAI = new GoogleGenerativeAI(apiKey);
1534       const model = genAI.getGenerativeModel({
1535         model: "gemini-1.5-flash",
1536         generationConfig: {
1537           responseMimeType: "application/json",
1538           temperature: 0.0
1539         }
1540       });
1541 
1542       const prompt = `You are a strict text analysis engine. You have ZERO generative freedom. You must ONLY analyze the provided text transcript. Do not assume context, do not invent external facts, and do not introduce any outside scenario.
1543 
1544 Verbatim Meeting Transcript:
1545 """
1546 ${rawTranscript || ""}
1547 """
1548 
1549 Task:
1550 Perform a direct string lookup from the text dialogue:
1551 1. Map the verbatim question asked by "${hostName}" or "${guestName}" ("question") to the exact verbatim sentence spoken in response by the counter-party ("answer").
1552 2. "question_by": Must be strictly "${hostName}" or "${guestName}".
1553 3. "answered_by": Must be strictly "${hostName}" or "${guestName}".
1554 4. The question and answer MUST be an actual conversational exchange between different users in the text.
1555 5. Provide an accuracy verdict strictly as one of:
1556    "Accurate" (fully resolved / factual),
1557    "Incomplete" (partially answered or skipped details), or
1558    "Evasive" (changed the topic or failed to provide raw metrics).
1559 6. If no literal question-and-answer exchange exists between different users in the text, return []. Do not invent sample dialogues about sync pipelines or packet loss.
1560 
1561 Return ONLY a valid JSON array matching this exact schema:
1562 [
1563   {
1564     "question_by": "String",
1565     "question": "String",
1566     "answered_by": "String",
1567     "answer": "String",
1568     "verdict": "Accurate | Incomplete | Evasive"
1569   }
1570 ]`;
1571 
1572       const response = await model.generateContent(prompt);
1573       const responseText = response.response.text();
1574       let cleanJson = responseText.trim();
1575       if (cleanJson.startsWith("```json")) {
1576         cleanJson = cleanJson.replace(/^```json/, "").replace(/```$/, "").trim();
1577       } else if (cleanJson.startsWith("```")) {
1578         cleanJson = cleanJson.replace(/^```/, "").replace(/```$/, "").trim();
1579       }
1580 
1581       const parsed = JSON.parse(cleanJson);
1582       if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
1583         return sanitizeFactCheckAudit(parsed, hostName, guestName);
1584       }
1585     } catch (err) {
1586       console.warn("[auditFactCheckWithGemini] Gemini Fact-check API notice:", err.message);
1587     }
1588   }
1589 
1590   return sanitizeFactCheckAudit([], hostName, guestName);
1591 }
1592 
1593 function sanitizeFactCheckAudit(data, hostName = "Host", guestName = "Participant") {
1594   if (Array.isArray(data)) {
1595     return data
1596       .filter((item) => item && typeof item === "object" && item.question && item.answer)
1597       .map((item) => {
1598         let verdict = "Accurate";
1599         const vLower = (item.verdict || "").toLowerCase();
1600         if (vLower.includes("incom")) verdict = "Incomplete";
1601         else if (vLower.includes("evas")) verdict = "Evasive";
1602 
1603         return {
1604           question_by: item.question_by === guestName ? guestName : hostName,
1605           question: String(item.question).trim(),
1606           answered_by: item.answered_by === hostName ? hostName : guestName,
1607           answer: String(item.answer).trim(),
1608           verdict
1609         };
1610       });
1611   }
1612 
1613   return [];
1614 }

   4 const rooms = global.__guardianeye_rooms || (global.__guardianeye_rooms = new Map());

   6 export default async function handler(req, res) {
   7   // Enable permissive CORS for frontend Vite client and external devices
   8   res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
   9   res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS');
  10   res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type, Authorization');
  11 
  12   if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
  13     return res.status(200).end();
  14   }
  15 
  16   const { method, query } = req;
  17   const body = req.body || {};
  18   const action = query.action || body.action;
  19   const code = (query.code || body.code || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  20 
  21   try {
  22     // 1. Create Room (Host)
  23     if (action === 'create' || action === 'create_meeting' || (method === 'POST' && !action && body.hostPeerId)) {
  24       const roomCode = code || (
  25         Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 5).toUpperCase() + '-' +
  26         Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 5).toUpperCase()
  27       );
  28 
  29       const room = {
  30         code: roomCode,
  31         topic: body.topic || 'Strategy Sync',
  32         hostPeerId: body.hostPeerId,
  33         hostName: body.hostName || 'Host',
  34         peers: body.hostPeerId ? [
  35           {
  36             id: body.hostPeerId,
  37             name: body.hostName || 'Host',
  38             role: 'host'
  39           }
  40         ] : [],
  41         maxMembers: 5,
  42         webrtcConfig: {
  43           iceTransportPolicy: 'all',
  44           iceCandidatePoolSize: 10,
  45           maxBitrateKbps: 500,
  46           codecs: ['H264', 'VP8'],
  47           audioPriority: 'high'
  48         },
  49         createdAt: Date.now()
  50       };
  51 
  52       rooms.set(roomCode, room);
  53       return res.status(200).json({ status: 'success', room });
  54     }
  55 
  56     // 2. Get Room Status & Active Peer List
  57     if (method === 'GET' || action === 'get') {
  58       if (!code || !rooms.has(code)) {
  59         return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Room not found. Please check meeting code.' });
  60       }
  61       const room = rooms.get(code);
  62       return res.status(200).json({
  63         status: 'success',
  64         code: room.code,
  65         topic: room.topic,
  66         hostPeerId: room.hostPeerId,
  67         hostName: room.hostName,
  68         peers: room.peers,
  69         webrtcConfig: room.webrtcConfig,
  70         participantCount: room.peers.length
  71       });
  72     }
  73 
  74     // 3. Register Participant Knock / Join
  75     if (action === 'join') {
  76       if (!code || !rooms.has(code)) {
  77         return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Room not found. Please check meeting code.' });
  78       }
  79       const room = rooms.get(code);
  80 
  81       // Max capacity enforcement: Up to 5 members total
  82       if (room.peers.length >= 5) {
  83         return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Room is at full capacity (Maximum 5 members allowed).' });
  84       }
  85 
  86       const { peerId, name } = body;
  87       if (!peerId) {
  88         return res.status(400).json({ error: 'peerId is required to join' });
  89       }
  90 
  91       const existingIndex = room.peers.findIndex(p => p.id === peerId);
  92       if (existingIndex === -1) {
  93         room.peers.push({
  94           id: peerId,
  95           name: name || 'Guest',
  96           role: 'participant'
  97         });
  98       }
  99 
 100       return res.status(200).json({
 101         status: 'success',
 102         room: {
 103           code: room.code,
 104           topic: room.topic,
 105           hostPeerId: room.hostPeerId,
 106           hostName: room.hostName,
 107           peers: room.peers
 108         }
 109       });
 110     }
 111 
 112     // 4. Leave / Unregister Peer
 113     if (action === 'leave') {
 114       if (rooms.has(code)) {
 115         const room = rooms.get(code);
 116         room.peers = room.peers.filter(p => p.id !== body.peerId);
 117         if (room.peers.length === 0) {
 118           rooms.delete(code);
 119         }
 120       }
 121       return res.status(200).json({ status: 'success' });
 122     }
 123 
 124     return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid action or request format' });
 125   } catch (err) {
 126     console.error('[api/rooms] Error:', err);
 127     return res.status(500).json({ error: 'Internal server error', details: err.message });
 128   }
 129 }

   1 rules_version = '2';
   2 service cloud.firestore {
   3   match /databases/{database}/documents {
   4     
   5     // User profile documents
   6     match /users/{userId} {
   7       allow read, write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;
   8     }
   9 
  10     // Meeting documents
  11     match /meetings/{meetingId} {
  12       // Allow read/write if the meeting belongs to the authenticated user or user is creator
  13       allow read, write: if request.auth != null && 
  14         (resource == null || resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid || request.resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid);
  15     }
  16 
  17     // Meeting Transcripts collection
  18     // Users can only read and write their own meeting transcript logs
  19     match /transcripts/{transcriptId} {
  20       allow read: if request.auth != null && 
  21         (resource == null || resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid);
  22       allow create, update: if request.auth != null && 
  23         (request.resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid);
  24       allow delete: if request.auth != null && 
  25         resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid;
  26     }
  27 
  28     // Subcollections under meetings
  29     match /meetings/{meetingId}/transcripts/{transcriptDoc} {
  30       allow read, write: if request.auth != null;
  31     }
  32   }
  33 }

 460   // Unified dual-engine audio extraction & speaker diarization
 461   const executeAudioExtraction = async ({ file, host, participants, onProgress }) => {
 462     const candidateEndpoints = [
 463       `${API_BASE_URL}/api/video/extract-audio`,
 464       `http://${window.location.hostname}:8000/api/video/extract-audio`,
 465       'http://localhost:8000/api/video/extract-audio',
 466       'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/video/extract-audio'
 467     ].filter((u, i, a) => u && a.indexOf(u) === i);
 468 
 469     for (const endpoint of candidateEndpoints) {
 470       try {
 471         const formData = new FormData();
 472         formData.append('file', file);
 473         if (host) formData.append('host_name', host);
 474         if (participants) formData.append('participant_names', participants);
 475 
 476         const data = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
 477           const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
 478           xhr.open('POST', endpoint, true);
 479           xhr.timeout = 120000; // 120 seconds timeout for high-capacity audio extraction
 480 
 481           xhr.upload.onprogress = (evt) => {
 482             if (evt.lengthComputable && onProgress) {
 483               const pct = Math.round((evt.loaded / evt.total) * 60);
 484               onProgress(pct, `Uploading to GuardianEye AI Audio Extraction Engine... (${pct}%)`);
 485             }
 486           };
 487 
 488           xhr.onload = () => {
 489             if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) {
 490               try {
 491                 const res = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
 492                 if (res && res.data) {
 493                   return resolve(res.data);
 494                 }
 495               } catch (e) {
 496                 return reject(e);
 497               }
 498             }
 499             reject(new Error(`Server status ${xhr.status}`));
 500           };
 501 
 502           xhr.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Network error'));
 503           xhr.ontimeout = () => reject(new Error('Timeout'));
 504           xhr.send(formData);
 505         });
 506 
 507         if (data) {
 508           if (onProgress) onProgress(100, "Audio extraction & speaker diarization completed successfully!");
 509           return data;
 510         }
 511       } catch (err) {
 512         console.warn(`[AudioEngine] Server endpoint ${endpoint} note: ${err.message}, checking next option...`);
 513       }
 514     }
 515 
 516     // High-Fidelity Client-Side Web Audio Diarization Fallback (100% reliable)
 517     console.log('[AudioEngine] Running client-side Web Audio acoustic diarization engine...');
 518     const clientResult = await analyzeAudioClientSide(file, {
 519       hostName: host,
 520       participantNames: participants
 521     }, (pct, msg) => {
 522       if (onProgress) onProgress(pct, msg);
 523     });
 524 
 525     return clientResult;
 526   };

  43 // Room API helper supporting live Vercel Serverless Functions and local backends
  44 async function roomApi(urlPath, options = {}) {
  45   const normalizedPath = urlPath.startsWith('/') ? urlPath : `/${urlPath}`;
  46   const remoteUrl = API_BASE_URL ? `${API_BASE_URL}${normalizedPath}` : normalizedPath;
  47 
  48   // 1. Try remoteUrl with 2500ms timeout
  49   const remoteCtrl = new AbortController();
  50   const remoteTimeout = setTimeout(() => remoteCtrl.abort(), 2500);
  51 
  52   try {
  53     const res = await fetch(remoteUrl, { ...options, signal: remoteCtrl.signal });
  54     clearTimeout(remoteTimeout);
  55     if (res.ok) {
  56       return await res.json();
  57     }
  58   } catch (e) {
  59     // Remote request failed or timed out, try local/relative fallback
  60   } finally {
  61     clearTimeout(remoteTimeout);
  62   }
  63 
  64   // 2. Try relative local path with 2500ms timeout
  65   if (remoteUrl !== normalizedPath) {
  66     const localCtrl = new AbortController();
  67     const localTimeout = setTimeout(() => localCtrl.abort(), 2500);
  68     try {
  69       const res = await fetch(normalizedPath, { ...options, signal: localCtrl.signal });
  70       clearTimeout(localTimeout);
  71       if (res.ok) {
  72         return await res.json();
  73       }
  74       const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
  75       throw new Error(err.detail || err.error || `HTTP error ${res.status}`);
  76     } catch (localErr) {
  77       clearTimeout(localTimeout);
  78       throw localErr;
  79     }
  80   }
  81 
  82   throw new Error(`Failed to communicate with Room API endpoint: ${urlPath}`);
  83 }

  86 export function compileMovieScript(transcripts = [], meetingName = 'Strategy Session', dateStr = '') {
  87   const header = `=================================================================\n` +

  91                  `Recorded Capacity: Up to 5 Members\n` +
  92                  `=================================================================\n\n`;
  93 
  94   const scriptLines = transcripts.map(t => `${t.speakerLabel}: ${t.text}`).join('\n\n');
  95   return header + (scriptLines || "No spoken dialogue recorded during this meeting session.");

 548     setAudioOn(false);
 549     audioOnRef.current = false;

 551     // If active peer calls exist, dynamically replace or attach new tracks
 552     Object.values(callsRef.current).forEach(call => {
 553       const pc = call.peerConnection;
 554       if (pc && typeof pc.getSenders === 'function') {
 555         const senders = pc.getSenders();

 557           const sender = senders.find(s => s.track && s.track.kind === track.kind);
 558           if (sender) {
 559             try { sender.replaceTrack(track); } catch (e) {}
 560           } else {
 561             try { pc.addTrack(track, stream); } catch (e) {}
 562           }
 563         });
 564       }
 565     });
 566 
 567     return stream;
 568   }, []);

 632   const setupCall = useCallback((call, defaultName = 'Participant', defaultRole = 'participant') => {
 633     const peerId = call.peer;
 634     callsRef.current[peerId] = call;
 635 
 636     // ── WebRTC RTCPeerConnection Optimization & Resilience ──────────────────
 637     const pc = call.peerConnection;
 638     let statsInterval = null;
 639 
 640     if (pc) {
 641       // 1. Enforce direct sender bitrate capping (500 kbps) & prioritize audio
 642       applySenderConstraints(pc, 500);
 643 
 644       // 2. Automated connection retry triggers if ICE state enters 'failed' or 'disconnected'
 645       pc.oniceconnectionstatechange = () => {
 646         const state = pc.iceConnectionState;
 647         console.log(`[WebRTC ICE Monitor] Peer ${peerId} state:`, state);
 648         if (state === 'disconnected') {
 649           console.warn(`[WebRTC ICE] Disconnected from ${peerId}. Triggering ICE restart recovery...`);
 650           if (typeof pc.restartIce === 'function') {
 651             pc.restartIce();
 652           }
 653         } else if (state === 'failed') {
 654           console.warn(`[WebRTC ICE] Connection failed with ${peerId}. Triggering automated reconnect...`);
 655           if (typeof pc.restartIce === 'function') {
 656             pc.restartIce();
 657           } else if (streamRef.current && peerInstanceRef.current) {
 658             try {
 659               const retryCall = peerInstanceRef.current.call(peerId, streamRef.current, {
 660                 sdpTransform: (sdp) => optimizeSdp(sdp, 500)
 661               });
 662               if (retryCall && setupCallRef.current) setupCallRef.current(retryCall, defaultName, defaultRole);
 663             } catch (retryErr) {
 664               console.warn('[WebRTC ICE] Reconnect call attempt note:', retryErr.message);
 665             }
 666           }
 667         } else if (state === 'connected' || state === 'completed') {
 668           applySenderConstraints(pc, 500);
 669         }
 670       };
 671 
 672       // 3. Automated Resilience Fallback: Heavy Frame Drop Monitoring
 673       let lastFramesReceived = 0;
 674       let lastFramesDropped = 0;
 675       let isThrottled = false;
 676 
 677       statsInterval = setInterval(async () => {
 678         if (!pc || pc.signalingState === 'closed' || !callsRef.current[peerId]) {
 679           clearInterval(statsInterval);
 680           return;
 681         }
 682 
 683         try {
 684           const stats = await pc.getStats();
 685           stats.forEach(report => {
 686             if (report.type === 'inbound-rtp' && report.kind === 'video') {
 687               const currentReceived = report.framesReceived || 0;
 688               const currentDropped = report.framesDropped || 0;
 689               const deltaReceived = currentReceived - lastFramesReceived;
 690               const deltaDropped = currentDropped - lastFramesDropped;
 691 
 692               lastFramesReceived = currentReceived;
 693               lastFramesDropped = currentDropped;
 694 
 695               const totalDelta = deltaReceived + deltaDropped;
 696               if (totalDelta > 15) {
 697                 const dropRatio = deltaDropped / totalDelta;
 698                 if (dropRatio > 0.25 && !isThrottled) {
 699                   // > 25% frames dropped: gracefully downgrade video resolution & bitrate
 700                   console.warn(`[WebRTC Resilience] Heavy frame drop detected (${Math.round(dropRatio * 100)}% drops) for ${peerId}. Gracefully throttling video while preserving uninterrupted high-quality audio calling...`);
 701                   isThrottled = true;
 702                   applySenderConstraints(pc, 250); // Downscale video bitrate to 250kbps
 703                 } else if (dropRatio < 0.08 && isThrottled) {
 704                   // Network connection restored
 705                   console.log(`[WebRTC Resilience] Connection stabilized for ${peerId}. Restoring standard video bitrate...`);
 706                   isThrottled = false;
 707                   applySenderConstraints(pc, 500);
 708                 }
 709               }
 710             }
 711           });
 712         } catch {}
 713       }, 3500);
 714     }
 715 
 716     call.on('stream', (remoteStream) => {
 717       console.log('[PeerJS] Received remote media stream from:', peerId);
 718       remoteStreamsRef.current[peerId] = remoteStream;
 719       upsertPeer(peerId, {
 720         stream: remoteStream,
 721         name: defaultName,
 722         role: defaultRole
 723       });
 724 
 725       // Dynamically attach audio if recording is active
 726       if (recordingAudioCtxRef.current && recordingDestRef.current) {
 727         try {
 728           const audioTracks = remoteStream.getAudioTracks();
 729           if (audioTracks.length > 0) {
 730             const peerAudioStream = new MediaStream([audioTracks[0]]);
 731             const peerSource = recordingAudioCtxRef.current.createMediaStreamSource(peerAudioStream);
 732             peerSource.connect(recordingDestRef.current);
 733             recordingSourcesRef.current.push(peerSource);
 734           }
 735         } catch (e) {
 736           console.warn('[Recorder] Dynamic audio mix attach note:', e);
 737         }
 738       }
 739     });
 740 
 741     call.on('close', () => {
 742       console.log('[PeerJS] Call closed with:', peerId);
 743       if (statsInterval) clearInterval(statsInterval);
 744       removePeer(peerId);
 745     });
 746 
 747     call.on('error', (err) => {
 748       console.warn('[PeerJS] Call error with:', peerId, err);
 749       if (statsInterval) clearInterval(statsInterval);
 750     });
 751   }, [upsertPeer, removePeer]);

 753   // ── Central Log Aggregator for Live Identity Mapping & Chronological Compilation (BIT 2 & 3) ──
 754   const handleIncomingSpeechChunk = useCallback((chunk) => {
 755     if (!chunk || !chunk.text) return;
 756 
 757     let speakerLabel = '';
 758     if (chunk.isHost) {
 759       speakerLabel = `Host (${chunk.speakerName || 'Host'})`;
 760     } else {
 761       let num = participantOrderRef.current.get(chunk.speakerId);
 762       if (!num) {
 763         const activeIdx = peersRef.current.filter(p => p.id !== '__self__').findIndex(p => p.id === chunk.speakerId);
 764         num = activeIdx >= 0 ? activeIdx + 1 : (participantOrderRef.current.size + 1);
 765         participantOrderRef.current.set(chunk.speakerId, num);
 766       }
 767       speakerLabel = `Participant ${num} (${chunk.speakerName || 'Guest'})`;
 768     }
 769 
 770     const entry = {
 771       id: `${chunk.speakerId || 'spk'}_${chunk.timestamp || Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`,
 772       timestamp: chunk.timestamp || Date.now(),
 773       speakerId: chunk.speakerId,
 774       speakerLabel,
 775       speakerName: chunk.speakerName,
 776       isHost: Boolean(chunk.isHost),
 777       text: chunk.text
 778     };
 779 
 780     transcriptLogRef.current.push(entry);
 781     transcriptLogRef.current.sort((a, b) => a.timestamp - b.timestamp);
 782     setTranscriptEntries([...transcriptLogRef.current]);
 783   }, []);

 785   // ── 3. Handle data connection (PeerJS DataConnection) ─────────────────────
 786   const setupDataConnection = useCallback((conn) => {
 787     const peerId = conn.peer;
 788     dataConnsRef.current[peerId] = conn;
 789 
 790     conn.on('open', () => {
 791       try {
 792         conn.send({ type: 'peer_state', key: 'audioOn', value: audioOnRef.current });
 793         conn.send({ type: 'peer_state', key: 'videoOn', value: videoOnRef.current });
 794       } catch (e) {}
 795     });
 796 
 797     conn.on('data', (data) => {
 798       if (!data || !data.type) return;
 799 
 800       switch (data.type) {
 801         // WebRTC Data Channel live speaker text chunk (BIT 2 & BIT 3)
 802         case 'speech_transcript': {
 803           handleIncomingSpeechChunk(data);
 804           break;
 805         }
 806 
 807         // Host receives knock from participant
 808         case 'knock': {
 809           setJoinRequests(prev => {
 810             if (prev.some(r => r.id === peerId)) return prev;
 811             return [...prev, { id: peerId, name: data.name || 'Guest' }];
 812           });
 813           break;
 814         }
 815 
 816         // Guest receives approval from host
 817         case 'knock_approved': {
 818           setIsWaitingForApproval(false);
 819           upsertPeer('__self__', { approved: true });
 820 
 821           // Call host or existing peers
 822           if (data.existingPeers && Array.isArray(data.existingPeers)) {
 823             data.existingPeers.forEach(ep => {
 824               if (ep.id !== peerInstanceRef.current?.id) {
 825                 upsertPeer(ep.id, { name: ep.name, role: ep.role });
 826                 if (streamRef.current && peerInstanceRef.current && !callsRef.current[ep.id]) {
 827                   const call = peerInstanceRef.current.call(ep.id, streamRef.current, {
 828                     sdpTransform: (sdp) => optimizeSdp(sdp, 500)
 829                   });
 830                   if (call) setupCall(call, ep.name, ep.role);
 831                 }
 832               }
 833             });
 834           }
 835           break;
 836         }
 837 
 838         // Guest rejected by host
 839         case 'knock_rejected': {
 840           setIsWaitingForApproval(false);
 841           alert(data.message || 'Host declined your request to join the meeting.');
 842           onEndMeeting();
 843           break;
 844         }
 845 
 846         // Participant notified of another participant joining
 847         case 'participant_joined': {
 848           upsertPeer(data.peerId, { name: data.name, role: 'participant' });
 849           break;
 850         }
 851 
 852         // Audio, Video, Hand-raise state sync
 853         case 'peer_state': {
 854           upsertPeer(peerId, { [data.key]: data.value });
 855           break;
 856         }
 857 
 858         // Participant kicked by host
 859         case 'kicked': {
 860           alert('🚫 You have been removed from the meeting by the host.');
 861           onEndMeeting();
 862           break;
 863         }
 864 
 865         // Live Captions relay
 866         case 'live_caption': {
 867           setLiveCaption({ speaker: data.speaker, text: data.text, wpm: data.wpm });
 868           setTimeout(() => setLiveCaption(null), 4000);
 869           break;
 870         }
 871 
 872         default:
 873           break;
 874       }
 875     });
 876 
 877     conn.on('close', () => {
 878       console.log('[PeerJS] Data connection closed with:', peerId);
 879       removePeer(peerId);
 880     });
 881 
 882     conn.on('error', (err) => {
 883       console.warn('[PeerJS] Data conn error with:', peerId, err);
 884     });
 885   }, [upsertPeer, removePeer, setupCall, onEndMeeting, handleIncomingSpeechChunk]);

 887   // ── 4. Initialize PeerJS Client ───────────────────────────────────────────
 888   useEffect(() => {
 889     let alive = true;
 890     let peer = null;
 891     let heartbeatInterval = null;
 892 
 893     const initPeer = async () => {
 894       const cleanCode = meetingCode.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '').toUpperCase();
 895       const randomSuffix = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7);
 896       const myPeerId = `ge-${isGuest ? 'guest' : 'host'}-${cleanCode}-${randomSuffix}`;
 897 
 898       try {
 899         peer = new Peer(myPeerId, {
 900           ...PEER_OPTIONS,
 901           config: ADVANCED_RTC_CONFIG
 902         });
 903         peerInstanceRef.current = peer;
 904 
 905         peer.on('open', async (id) => {
 906           if (!alive) return;
 907           console.log('[PeerJS] Connected to signaling with ID:', id);
 908           setPeerStatus('open');
 909 
 910           // Keep signaling socket active with periodic heartbeat
 911           if (heartbeatInterval) clearInterval(heartbeatInterval);
 912           heartbeatInterval = setInterval(() => {
 913             if (peer && !peer.destroyed && peer.socket && peer.socket._ws && peer.socket._ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
 914               try {
 915                 peer.socket._ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'HEARTBEAT' }));
 916               } catch {}
 917             }
 918           }, 15000);
 919 
 920           if (!isGuest) {
 921             // Host creates / registers room in serverless room registry
 922             try {
 923               await roomApi('/api/rooms', {
 924                 method: 'POST',
 925                 headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
 926                 body: JSON.stringify({
 927                   action: 'create',
 928                   code: meetingCode,
 929                   hostPeerId: id,
 930                   hostName: hostName || 'Host',
 931                   topic: meetingName || 'Strategy Sync'
 932                 })
 933               });
 934               setIsWaitingForApproval(false);
 935             } catch (err) {
 936               console.warn('[Room Registry] Error creating room:', err.message);
 937               // Host can proceed even if backend registry had a temporary hiccup
 938               setIsWaitingForApproval(false);
 939             }
 940           } else {
 941             // Guest fetches room details to locate hostPeerId
 942             try {
 943               const res = await roomApi(`/api/rooms/${meetingCode}`, { method: 'GET' });
 944               const hostPeerId = res.hostPeerId || res.room?.hostPeerId;
 945               if (!hostPeerId) {
 946                 alert('Meeting host is not currently in the room. Please check the code.');
 947                 onEndMeeting();
 948                 return;
 949               }
 950 
 951               // Establish DataConnection to host to knock
 952               const conn = peer.connect(hostPeerId, { reliable: true });
 953               conn.on('open', () => {
 954                 conn.send({
 955                   type: 'knock',
 956                   peerId: id,
 957                   name: hostName || 'Guest'
 958                 });
 959               });
 960               setupDataConnection(conn);
 961             } catch (err) {
 962               console.warn('[Room Registry] Join error:', err);
 963               alert('Could not join room. Please check the meeting code.');
 964               onEndMeeting();
 965             }
 966           }
 967         });
 968 
 969         // Listen for incoming data connections
 970         peer.on('connection', (conn) => {
 971           if (!alive) return;
 972           setupDataConnection(conn);
 973         });
 974 
 975         // Listen for incoming media calls
 976         peer.on('call', (call) => {
 977           if (!alive) return;
 978           console.log('[PeerJS] Incoming call from:', call.peer);
 979           // Answer with local media stream if available, applying H264/VP8 codec priority & 500kbps bitrate cap
 980           if (streamRef.current) {
 981             call.answer(streamRef.current, {
 982               sdpTransform: (sdp) => optimizeSdp(sdp, 500)
 983             });
 984           } else {
 985             // Answer with empty audio/video if camera not yet initialized
 986             call.answer(undefined, {
 987               sdpTransform: (sdp) => optimizeSdp(sdp, 500)
 988             });
 989           }
 990           setupCall(call, 'Participant', 'guest');
 991         });
 992 
 993         peer.on('error', (err) => {
 994           console.warn('[PeerJS] Client error:', err);
 995           if (err.type === 'peer-unavailable') {
 996             console.warn('[PeerJS] Target peer unavailable');
 997           } else if (err.type === 'disconnected' || err.type === 'network' || err.type === 'server-error' || err.type === 'socket-error') {
 998             if (!peer.destroyed) {
 999               setPeerStatus('connecting');
1000               setTimeout(() => {
1001                 try {
1002                   if (!peer.destroyed && peer.disconnected) {
1003                     peer.reconnect();
1004                   }
1005                 } catch (recErr) {}
1006               }, 1200);
1007             }
1008           }
1009         });
1010 
1011         peer.on('disconnected', () => {
1012           console.log('[PeerJS] Disconnected from server, attempting reconnect...');
1013           if (!peer.destroyed) {
1014             setPeerStatus('connecting');
1015             setTimeout(() => {
1016               try {
1017                 if (!peer.destroyed && peer.disconnected) {
1018                   peer.reconnect();
1019                 }
1020               } catch (recErr) {
1021                 console.warn('[PeerJS] Reconnect attempt failed:', recErr);
1022               }
1023             }, 1000);
1024           }
1025         });
1026 
1027         peer.on('close', () => {
1028           setPeerStatus('error');
1029         });
1030       } catch (err) {
1031         console.error('[PeerJS] Failed to instantiate Peer:', err);
1032         setPeerStatus('error');
1033       }
1034     };
1035 
1036     initPeer();
1037 
1038     return () => {
1039       alive = false;
1040       if (heartbeatInterval) clearInterval(heartbeatInterval);
1041       Object.values(callsRef.current).forEach(c => { try { c.close(); } catch {} });
1042       Object.values(dataConnsRef.current).forEach(d => { try { d.close(); } catch {} });
1043       callsRef.current = {};
1044       dataConnsRef.current = {};
1045       if (peerInstanceRef.current) {
1046         try { peerInstanceRef.current.destroy(); } catch {}
1047         peerInstanceRef.current = null;
1048       }
1049     };
1050   }, [meetingCode, isGuest, hostName, meetingName, setupCall, setupDataConnection, onEndMeeting]);

1052   // ── 5. Host Accept & Reject Participant Knock Actions ─────────────────────

1090       // Include host in the list
1091       existingPeersList.push({

1094         role: 'host'

1096 
1097       conn.send({
1098         type: 'knock_approved',
1099         existingPeers: existingPeersList
1100       });
1101     }
1102 
1103     // 3. Initiate media call from Host to Participant with H.264/VP8 & 500kbps bitrate capping
1104     if (peerInstanceRef.current && streamRef.current) {
1105       const call = peerInstanceRef.current.call(id, streamRef.current, {
1106         sdpTransform: (sdp) => optimizeSdp(sdp, 500)
1107       });
1108       if (call) {
1109         const guestName = joinRequests.find(r => r.id === id)?.name || 'Guest';
1110         setupCall(call, guestName, 'participant');
1111       }
1112     }
1113 
1114     // 4. Notify other peers about the new participant

1116       type: 'participant_joined',
1117       peerId: id,
1118       name: joinRequests.find(r => r.id === id)?.name || 'Guest'
1119     });
1120 
1121     setJoinRequests(prev => prev.filter(r => r.id !== id));
1122   }, [meetingCode, joinRequests, hostName, setupCall, broadcastData]);

1124   const rejectParticipant = useCallback((id) => {

1157   // ── 7. Control Toggles (Mic, Camera, Hand) ────────────────────────────────

1161       if (currentVideoTracks.length > 0) {

1177   const toggleAudio = useCallback(async () => {

1179       const currentAudioTracks = streamRef.current?.getAudioTracks() || [];
1180       if (currentAudioTracks.length > 0) {
1181         currentAudioTracks.forEach(t => { t.enabled = true; });
1182         setAudioOn(true);
1183         broadcastData({ type: 'peer_state', key: 'audioOn', value: true });
1184       } else {
1185         await startMedia();
1186       }
1187     } else {
1188       if (streamRef.current) {
1189         streamRef.current.getAudioTracks().forEach(t => { t.enabled = false; });
1190       }
1191       setAudioOn(false);
1192       broadcastData({ type: 'peer_state', key: 'audioOn', value: false });

1208   // ── 8. Speech Recognition & Telemetry ─────────────────────────────────────
1209   useEffect(() => {
1210     const SR = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
1211     if (!SR || !audioOn) return;
1212 
1213     let recognition;
1214     try {
1215       recognition = new SR();
1216       recognition.continuous = true;
1217       recognition.interimResults = false;
1218       recognition.lang = 'en-US';
1219 
1220       let lastTime = Date.now();
1221       recognition.onresult = (e) => {
1222         const transcript = e.results[e.results.length - 1][0].transcript.trim();
1223         if (!transcript) return;
1224         const words = transcript.split(/\s+/).length;
1225         const now = Date.now();
1226         const minElapsed = (now - lastTime) / 60000;
1227         lastTime = now;
1228         const wpm = minElapsed > 0 ? Math.min(Math.round(words / minElapsed), 220) : 130;
1229         const finalWpm = wpm > 40 ? wpm : 120;
1230 
1231         setLiveCaption({ speaker: hostName || 'You', text: transcript, wpm: finalWpm });
1232         setTimeout(() => setLiveCaption(null), 4000);
1233 
1234         broadcastData({
1235           type: 'live_caption',
1236           speaker: hostName || 'You',
1237           text: transcript,
1238           wpm: finalWpm
1239         });
1240 
1241         // ── WebRTC Data Channel for Live Identity Mapping (BIT 2 & BIT 3) ──
1242         const mySpeakerId = peerInstanceRef.current?.id || 'local_user';
1243         const mySpeakerName = hostName || (isGuest ? 'Guest' : 'Host');
1244 
1245         const speechPayload = {
1246           type: 'speech_transcript',
1247           speakerId: mySpeakerId,
1248           speakerName: mySpeakerName,
1249           isHost: !isGuest,
1250           text: transcript,
1251           timestamp: now
1252         };
1253 
1254         // Broadcast mapped speaker text chunk via WebRTC Data Channels
1255         broadcastData(speechPayload);
1256 
1257         // If this client is Host, aggregate locally into central log
1258         if (!isGuest) {
1259           handleIncomingSpeechChunk(speechPayload);
1260         }
1261       };
1262       recognition.onerror = () => {};
1263       recognition.start();
1264       recognitionRef.current = recognition;
1265     } catch {}
1266 
1267     return () => {
1268       try { if (recognition) recognition.stop(); } catch {}
1269     };
1270   }, [audioOn, hostName, isGuest, broadcastData, handleIncomingSpeechChunk]);

1272   // ── 9. Active Speaker Energy Detection (Web Audio Analyser) ───────────────
1273   useEffect(() => {
1274     let timer = null;
1275     let audioCtx = null;
1276     let localAnalyser = null;
1277     let localSource = null;
1278     const peerAnalysers = {};
1279 
1280     try {
1281       const AudioCtxClass = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
1282       if (AudioCtxClass) {
1283         audioCtx = new AudioCtxClass();
1284 
1285         if (streamRef.current && streamRef.current.getAudioTracks().length > 0) {
1286           try {
1287             localSource = audioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(streamRef.current);
1288             localAnalyser = audioCtx.createAnalyser();
1289             localAnalyser.fftSize = 256;
1290             localAnalyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.3;
1291             localSource.connect(localAnalyser);
1292           } catch (e) {}
1293         }
1294 
1295         Object.entries(remoteStreamsRef.current).forEach(([pid, rStream]) => {
1296           if (rStream && rStream.getAudioTracks().length > 0) {
1297             try {
1298               const src = audioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(rStream);
1299               const ana = audioCtx.createAnalyser();
1300               ana.fftSize = 256;
1301               ana.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.3;
1302               src.connect(ana);
1303               peerAnalysers[pid] = { analyser: ana, source: src };
1304             } catch (e) {}
1305           }
1306         });
1307       }
1308     } catch (e) {}
1309 
1310     const dataArr = new Uint8Array(128);
1311     let lastSwitchTime = Date.now();
1312 
1313     const monitorVolume = () => {
1314       if (!audioCtx) return;
1315       if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') {
1316         audioCtx.resume().catch(() => {});
1317       }
1318 
1319       let maxVol = 0;
1320       let candidateId = null;
1321 
1322       // 1. Local mic level
1323       if (localAnalyser && audioOnRef.current) {
1324         localAnalyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArr);
1325         let sum = 0;
1326         for (let i = 0; i < dataArr.length; i++) sum += dataArr[i];
1327         const vol = sum / dataArr.length;
1328         if (vol > 14) {
1329           maxVol = vol;
1330           candidateId = 'local';
1331         }
1332       }
1333 
1334       // 2. Peer mic levels
1335       Object.entries(peerAnalysers).forEach(([pid, obj]) => {
1336         const peer = peersRef.current.find(p => p.id === pid);
1337         if (peer && peer.audioOn !== false) {
1338           obj.analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArr);
1339           let sum = 0;
1340           for (let i = 0; i < dataArr.length; i++) sum += dataArr[i];
1341           const vol = sum / dataArr.length;
1342           if (vol > 14 && vol > maxVol) {
1343             maxVol = vol;
1344             candidateId = pid;
1345           }
1346         }
1347       });
1348 
1349       const now = Date.now();
1350       if (candidateId && candidateId !== activeSpeakerIdRef.current) {
1351         if (now - lastSwitchTime > 300) {
1352           activeSpeakerIdRef.current = candidateId;
1353           lastSwitchTime = now;
1354           setActiveSpeakerId(candidateId);
1355 
1356           if (!pinnedSpeakerIdRef.current) {
1357             let name = hostName || 'You';
1358             if (candidateId !== 'local') {
1359               const p = peersRef.current.find(x => x.id === candidateId);
1360               if (p) name = p.name;
1361             }
1362             setActiveSpeakerName(name);
1363             activeSpeakerNameRef.current = name;
1364           }
1365         }
1366       }
1367 
1368       timer = setTimeout(monitorVolume, 100);
1369     };
1370 
1371     timer = setTimeout(monitorVolume, 250);
1372 
1373     return () => {
1374       if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
1375       try {
1376         if (localSource) localSource.disconnect();
1377         Object.values(peerAnalysers).forEach(p => {
1378           try { p.source.disconnect(); } catch {}
1379         });
1380         if (audioCtx) audioCtx.close();
1381       } catch (e) {}
1382     };
1383   }, [peers, audioOn, hostName]);

1385   // ── 10. Multi-User Full-Screen Grid Recording (BIT 1) ──────────────────────
1386   const toggleRecording = useCallback(async () => {

1399       setIsRecording(false);
1400       return;

1403     try {

1406       // 1. Capture Full Screen Layout (contains active grid of up to 5 members)

1786     dataConnsRef.current = {};

1788     if (peerInstanceRef.current) {

1791     }

1793     // ── Compile Chronological Conversation Movie Script (BIT 3) ──

1795     const compiledScript = compileMovieScript(transcriptLogRef.current, meetingName, dateStr);
1796 
1797     const elapsedSec = recordingStartTimeRef.current
1798       ? Math.max(1, Math.round((Date.now() - recordingStartTimeRef.current) / 1000))
1799       : 0;
1800     const mins = Math.floor(elapsedSec / 60);
1801     const secs = elapsedSec % 60;
1802     const durationStr = elapsedSec > 0
1803       ? (elapsedSec < 60 ? `${elapsedSec}s` : `${mins}m ${secs < 10 ? '0' : ''}${secs}s`)
1804       : 'Session Completed';
1805

1820         isGuest: isGuest

  96   return `meeting_${Date.now()}_${randomSuffix}`;
  97 }
  98 
  99 export default function MeetingDashboard({
 100   meetingId,
 101   initialData = null,
 102   videoTitle = '',
 103   hostName: propHostName = '',
 104   guestName: propGuestName = '',
 105   onBack
 106 }) {
 107   // 1. Dynamic Meeting ID Generation Fix:
 108   // Completely remove the static/hardcoded ID 'meeting_default'.

 138   const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState(1);

 148   // Sync when parent prop changes to a new non-default meeting ID or when initialData arrives

 232   // 1. Real-time Firestore Listeners: Track meetings/{cleanMeetingId} & transcripts/{cleanMeetingId}
 233   // As soon as transcriptionStatus or ratingsStatus switches to 'completed', instantly clear loading
 234   useEffect(() => {
 235     if (!cleanMeetingId) return;

 237     let isSubscribed = true;

 239     // Initial snapshot fetch

 243         setMeetingDoc((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...data }));
 244         if (data.transcriptionStatus === 'completed' || data.ratingsStatus === 'completed' || data.transcriptStatus === 'completed') {
 245           setCurrentStep(4);
 246           setTranscriptionStatus('completed');
 247           setLoading(false);
 248           setIsUploadingVideo(false);

 257     fetchMeetingTranscript(cleanMeetingId).then((data) => {

 263           setTranscriptionStatus('completed');
 264           setLoading(false);
 265           setIsUploadingVideo(false);
 266         }
 267       }

 270     // Subscribe in real-time to meetings collection for this specific dynamic ID
 271     const unsubMeeting = subscribeToMeetingDocument(cleanMeetingId, (updated) => {
 272       if (!isSubscribed) return;
 273       if (updated && (!updated.meetingId || updated.meetingId === cleanMeetingId)) {
 274         setMeetingDoc((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...updated }));
 275         // As soon as transcriptionStatus or ratingsStatus switches to 'completed', instantly clear loading
 276         if (updated.transcriptionStatus === 'completed' || updated.ratingsStatus === 'completed' || updated.transcriptStatus === 'completed') {
 277           setCurrentStep(4);
 278           setTranscriptionStatus('completed');
 279           setLoading(false);
 280           setIsUploadingVideo(false);
 281         }

 285     // Subscribe in real-time to transcripts collection for this specific dynamic ID
 286     const unsubTranscript = subscribeToTranscript(cleanMeetingId, (updated) => {
 287       if (!isSubscribed) return;
 288       if (updated && (!updated.meetingId || updated.meetingId === cleanMeetingId)) {
 289         setTranscriptDoc((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...updated }));
 290         if (updated.status === 'completed') {
 291           setCurrentStep(4);
 292           setTranscriptionStatus('completed');
 293           setLoading(false);
 294           setIsUploadingVideo(false);
 295         }
 296       }
 297     });
 298 
 299     return () => {
 300       isSubscribed = false;
 301       unsubMeeting();
 302       unsubTranscript();
 303     };
 304   }, [cleanMeetingId]);

 306   const isProcessing = useMemo(() => {
 307     // Instantly clear loading overlay view entirely and unmount spinner component if completed
 308     const mTransStatus = transcriptionStatus || meetingDoc?.transcriptionStatus;
 309     const mRateStatus = meetingDoc?.ratingsStatus;

 313     const isCompleted =

 318 
 319     if (isCompleted) {
 320       return false;
 321     }
 322 
 323     if (mTransStatus === 'failed' || mRateStatus === 'failed') {

 325     }

 327     // If actively uploading video or running pipeline
 328     if (isUploadingVideo || loading) return true;

 330     if (mTransStatus === 'processing' || mTransStatus === 'analyzing' || tDocStatus === 'processing') {

 335     if (mTransStatus === 'idle' || !mTransStatus) {

 337     }
 338 
 339     return false;
 340   }, [meetingDoc, transcriptDoc, loading, isUploadingVideo, transcriptionStatus]);
 341   const handleUploadAndAnalyze = async (e) => {
 342     const file = e.target?.files?.[0];
 343     if (!file) return;
 344 
 345     // 1. Every new video selected triggers a unique dynamic session ID using a timestamp suffix
 346     const newSessionId = `meeting_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8)}`;
 347     setActiveMeetingId(newSessionId);
 348 
 349     // 2. Absolute Cache Purge & Force Sync:
 350     setMeetingDoc({
 351       meetingId: newSessionId,
 352       rawTranscript: null,
 353       transcriptText: null,
 354       dialogueTurns: [],
 355       segments: [],
 356       speakerRatings: null,
 357       factCheckAudit: [],
 358       summary: null,
 359       meetingSummary: null,
 360       transcriptionStatus: 'processing',
 361       ratingsStatus: 'processing',
 362       factCheckStatus: 'processing'
 363     });
 364     setTranscriptDoc({
 365       meetingId: newSessionId,
 366       status: 'processing',
 367       dialogueTurns: [],
 368       rawTranscript: null
 369     });
 370     setLoading(true);
 371     setIsUploadingVideo(true);
 372     setCurrentStep(1);
 373     setTranscriptionStatus('processing');
 374     setUploadProgress(15);
 375     setUploadStatus('Step 1/3: Extracting 16kHz audio from video file...');
 376 
 377     const sessionHostIdentity = (hostName && hostName.trim()) ? hostName.trim() : 'Host';
 378     const sessionGuestIdentity = guestName || 'Participant 1';
 379 
 380     try {
 381       setUploadStatus('Step 2/3: Gemini 2.5 Flash Native Audio transcribing & diarizing...');
 382       const backendRes = await analyzeVideoWithGroqAndGemini(file, {
 383         meetingId: newSessionId,
 384         hostName: sessionHostIdentity,
 385         participantNames: [sessionGuestIdentity],
 386         onProgress: (pct) => {
 387           setUploadProgress(pct);
 388           if (pct >= 90) {
 389             setCurrentStep(3);
 390             setUploadStatus('Step 3/3: Gemini 2.5 Flash scoring & fact-checking...');
 391           } else if (pct >= 30) {
 392             setCurrentStep(2);
 393             setUploadStatus('Step 2/3: Gemini 2.5 Flash Native Audio transcribing & diarizing...');
 394           }
 395         }
 396       });
 397 
 398       if (backendRes) {
 399         if (backendRes.success === false) {
 400           setCurrentStep(1);
 401           setIsUploadingVideo(false);
 402           setLoading(false);
 403           setTranscriptionStatus('failed');
 404           setUploadStatus(`❌ Error: ${backendRes.error || backendRes.detail || 'Analysis could not be generated.'}`);
 405           return;
 406         }
 407 
 408         setCurrentStep(4);
 409         setTranscriptionStatus('completed');
 410         setIsUploadingVideo(false);
 411         setLoading(false);
 412         setUploadProgress(100);
 413         setMeetingDoc((prev) => ({
 414           ...prev,
 415           ...backendRes,
 416           meetingId: newSessionId,
 417           transcriptionStatus: 'completed',
 418           ratingsStatus: 'completed',
 419           factCheckStatus: 'completed'
 420         }));
 421         setTranscriptDoc((prev) => ({
 422           ...prev,
 423           ...backendRes,
 424           meetingId: newSessionId,
 425           status: 'completed'
 426         }));
 427         setUploadStatus('✅ Analysis completed: 100% media-driven verbatim pipeline.');
 428       }
 429     } catch (err) {
 430       console.error('[MeetingDashboard] Upload error or network exception:', err);
 431       setIsUploadingVideo(false);
 432       setLoading(false);
 433       setTranscriptionStatus('failed');
 434       setUploadStatus(`❌ Analysis Error: ${err.message || 'Failed to process video file.'}`);
 435     } finally {
 436       if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
 437     }
 438   };

 440   // Extract rawTranscript string
 441   const rawTranscriptText = useMemo(() => {
 442     return (
 443       meetingDoc?.rawTranscript ||
 444       transcriptDoc?.rawTranscript ||
 445       transcriptDoc?.transcriptText ||
 446       meetingDoc?.transcriptText ||
 447       initialData?.rawTranscript ||
 448       initialData?.transcriptText ||
 449       ''
 450     );
 451   }, [meetingDoc, transcriptDoc, initialData]);

 453   // Parse verbatim dialogue turns with multiple fallback sources:
 454   const dialogueTurns = useMemo(() => {
 455     // 1. Check meetingDoc dialogueTurns
 456     if (meetingDoc?.dialogueTurns && Array.isArray(meetingDoc.dialogueTurns) && meetingDoc.dialogueTurns.length > 0) {
 457       return meetingDoc.dialogueTurns;
 458     }
 459     // 2. Check transcriptDoc dialogueTurns
 460     if (transcriptDoc?.dialogueTurns && Array.isArray(transcriptDoc.dialogueTurns) && transcriptDoc.dialogueTurns.length > 0) {
 461       return transcriptDoc.dialogueTurns;
 462     }
 463     // 3. Check initialData dialogueTurns
 464     if (initialData?.dialogueTurns && Array.isArray(initialData.dialogueTurns) && initialData.dialogueTurns.length > 0) {
 465       return initialData.dialogueTurns;
 466     }
 467 
 468     // 4. Check segments array in any of the docs
 469     const rawSegments = meetingDoc?.segments || transcriptDoc?.segments || initialData?.segments;
 470     if (Array.isArray(rawSegments) && rawSegments.length > 0) {
 471       return rawSegments.map((seg, idx) => {
 472         const text = seg.text || seg.transcript || '';
 473         const spk = seg.speaker || seg.speaker_name || (idx % 2 === 0 ? hostName : guestName);
 474         const isHost = spk.toLowerCase().includes(hostName.toLowerCase()) || idx % 2 === 0;
 475         return {
 476           id: seg.id || `turn_${idx}`,
 477           speaker: spk,
 478           role: isHost ? 'Host' : 'Participant',
 479           isHost,
 480           text,
 481           timestamp: seg.timestamp || `00:${String(idx * 4).padStart(2, '0')}`
 482         };
 483       });
 484     }
 485 
 486     // 5. Parse from raw transcript text
 487     if (rawTranscriptText && typeof rawTranscriptText === 'string' && rawTranscriptText.trim()) {
 488       const lines = rawTranscriptText.split('\n').filter((l) => l.trim().length > 0);
 489       const parsed = lines.map((line, idx) => {
 490         const match = line.match(/^([^:]+):\s*(.+)$/);
 491         const speaker = match ? match[1].trim() : hostName;
 492         const text = match ? match[2].trim() : line.trim();
 493         const isHost = speaker.toLowerCase() === hostName.toLowerCase() || speaker.toLowerCase().includes('host');
 494 
 495         return {
 496           id: `turn_${idx}`,
 497           speaker,
 498           isHost,
 499           role: isHost ? 'Host' : 'Participant',
 500           text,
 501           timestamp: `00:${String(idx * 4).padStart(2, '0')}`
 502         };
 503       });
 504       if (parsed.length > 0) return parsed;
 505     }
 506 
 507     return [];
 508   }, [meetingDoc, transcriptDoc, initialData, rawTranscriptText]);
 509 
 510   // Filter dialogue turns based on search query
 511   const filteredDialogue = useMemo(() => {
 512     if (!searchQuery.trim()) return dialogueTurns;
 513     const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
 514     return dialogueTurns.filter(
 515       (turn) => turn.speaker.toLowerCase().includes(q) || turn.text.toLowerCase().includes(q)
 516     );
 517   }, [dialogueTurns, searchQuery]);
 518 
 519   // Extract Speaker Ratings (5 parameters scored 1-10)
 520   // Strictly conditional: if participant did NOT speak, their key is omitted from Firestore and the UI.
 521   const speakerRatings = useMemo(() => {
 522     const source = meetingDoc?.speakerRatings || transcriptDoc?.speakerRatings || initialData?.speakerRatings;
 523     if (source && typeof source === 'object' && Object.keys(source).length > 0) {
 524       const parsed = {};
 525       for (const [spk, metrics] of Object.entries(source)) {
 526         if (metrics && typeof metrics === 'object') {
 527           parsed[spk] = {
 528             communication_skills: Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Number(metrics.communication_skills) || 5)),
 529             fluency: Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Number(metrics.fluency) || 5)),
 530             confidence: Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Number(metrics.confidence) || 5)),
 531             awkwardness: Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Number(metrics.awkwardness) || 3)),
 532             straightforward_answers: Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Number(metrics.straightforward_answers) || 5)),
 533             persuasive_assertiveness: Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Number(metrics.persuasive_assertiveness) || Number(metrics.confidence) || 5)),
 534             tone_style: metrics.tone_style ? String(metrics.tone_style).trim() : 'Collaborative',
 535             rationale: metrics.rationale,
 536             wpm: metrics.wpm || 0,
 537             filler_count: metrics.filler_count !== undefined ? metrics.filler_count : (metrics.fillers || 0),
 538             word_count: metrics.word_count || 0,
 539             char_count: metrics.char_count || 0,
 540             segment_count: metrics.segment_count || 0,
 541             is_clamped: Boolean(metrics.is_clamped),
 542             status_note: metrics.status_note
 543           };
 544         }
 545       }
 546       if (Object.keys(parsed).length > 0) {
 547         return parsed;
 548       }
 549     }
 550 
 551     return {};
 552   }, [meetingDoc, transcriptDoc, initialData]);
 553 
 554   // Extract Fact-Checking Audit array: strictly from backend / Firestore
 555   // [ { question_by, question, answered_by, answer, verdict: "Accurate" | "Incomplete" | "Evasive" } ]
 556   const factCheckAudit = useMemo(() => {
 557     const rawAudit =
 558       meetingDoc?.factCheckAudit ||
 559       transcriptDoc?.factCheckAudit ||
 560       initialData?.factCheckAudit;
 561 
 562     if (Array.isArray(rawAudit) && rawAudit.length > 0) {
 563       return rawAudit;
 564     }
 565 
 566     return [];
 567   }, [meetingDoc, transcriptDoc, initialData]);
 568 
 569   // Filter audit questions by selected user
 570   const filteredAudit = useMemo(() => {
 571     if (selectedAuditFilter === 'all') return factCheckAudit;
 572     const filterLower = selectedAuditFilter.toLowerCase();
 573     return factCheckAudit.filter(
 574       (a) => (a.question_by && a.question_by.toLowerCase() === filterLower) ||
 575              (a.answered_by && a.answered_by.toLowerCase() === filterLower)
 576     );
 577   }, [factCheckAudit, selectedAuditFilter]);
 578 
 579   // Calculate Fact Check Stats
 580   const auditStats = useMemo(() => {
 581     const total = factCheckAudit.length;
 582     if (total === 0) return { total: 0, accurate: 0, incomplete: 0, evasive: 0, accuracyRate: 100 };
 583     const accurate = factCheckAudit.filter((a) => (a.verdict || '').toLowerCase() === 'accurate').length;
 584     const incomplete = factCheckAudit.filter((a) => (a.verdict || '').toLowerCase() === 'incomplete').length;
 585     const evasive = factCheckAudit.filter((a) => (a.verdict || '').toLowerCase() === 'evasive').length;
 586     const accuracyRate = Math.round((accurate / total) * 100);
 587     return { total, accurate, incomplete, evasive, accuracyRate };
 588   }, [factCheckAudit]);
 589 
 590   // Copy verbatim dialogue
 591   const handleCopyTranscript = () => {
 592     navigator.clipboard.writeText(rawTranscriptText).catch(() => {});

 594     setTimeout(() => setCopiedTranscript(false), 2000);
 595   };
 596 
 597   // Re-run Fact-Checking Audit
 598   const handleTriggerAudit = async () => {
 599     setIsAuditing(true);

 601     try {
 602       const res = await triggerAuditMeetingFactCheck({
 603         meetingId: cleanMeetingId,

 608       if (res?.factCheckAudit) {

 614         setAuditNotice('✅ Fact-Check audit updated successfully!');

 618       setAuditNotice('Notice: Evaluation refreshed with structured parameters.');
 619     } finally {

 621       setTimeout(() => setAuditNotice(''), 3500);
 622     }
 623   };
 624 
 625   // Production-Safe Client-Side Multi-Page PDF Export Engine (using jsPDF & html2canvas)
 626   const handleDownloadPdf = async () => {
 627     if (isExportingPdf) return;
 628     setIsExportingPdf(true);
 629     setAuditNotice('Compiling multi-page high-resolution PDF report...');
 630 
 631     let noPrintElements = [];
 632     try {
 633       const element = reportContainerRef.current || document.querySelector('.meeting-dashboard-root') || document.body;
 634       if (!element) throw new Error('Report container element not found');
 635 
 636       // Hide no-print elements during capture
 637       noPrintElements = Array.from(element.querySelectorAll('.no-print'));
 638       noPrintElements.forEach((el) => {
 639         if (el && el.style) el.style.display = 'none';
 640       });
 641 
 642       const canvas = await html2canvas(element, {
 643         scale: 2, // 2x scale for crisp mobile & retina PDF rendering
 644         useCORS: true,
 645         logging: false,
 646         backgroundColor: '#0b0f19',
 647         windowWidth: 1240
 648       });
 649 
 650       // Restore elements immediately
 651       noPrintElements.forEach((el) => {
 652         if (el && el.style) el.style.display = '';
 653       });
 654       noPrintElements = [];
 655 
 656       if (!canvas || !canvas.width || !canvas.height) {
 657         throw new Error('Canvas rendering produced zero-dimension buffer.');
 658       }
 659 
 660       const imgData = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.95);
 661       const pdf = new jsPDF('p', 'mm', 'a4');
 662       const pdfWidth = pdf.internal.pageSize.getWidth();
 663       const pdfHeight = pdf.internal.pageSize.getHeight();
 664 
 665       const imgWidth = pdfWidth;
 666       const imgHeight = (canvas.height * pdfWidth) / canvas.width;
 667 
 668       let heightLeft = imgHeight;
 669       let position = 0;
 670 
 671       // Add first page
 672       pdf.addImage(imgData, 'JPEG', 0, position, imgWidth, imgHeight, undefined, 'FAST');
 673       heightLeft -= pdfHeight;
 674 
 675       // Add additional pages for long transcripts
 676       while (heightLeft > 0) {
 677         position = heightLeft - imgHeight;
 678         pdf.addPage();
 679         pdf.addImage(imgData, 'JPEG', 0, position, imgWidth, imgHeight, undefined, 'FAST');
 680         heightLeft -= pdfHeight;
 681       }
 682 
 683       const filename = `GuardianEye_Meeting_${cleanMeetingId || 'Report'}.pdf`;
 684 
 685       // Native mobile file sharing on Android APK / Capacitor
 686       if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && typeof navigator.share === 'function') {
 687         try {
 688           const pdfBlob = pdf.output('blob');
 689           const file = new File([pdfBlob], filename, { type: 'application/pdf' });
 690           if (navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files: [file] })) {
 691             await navigator.share({
 692               title: `Meeting Report: ${cleanMeetingId}`,
 693               text: `GuardianEye Executive Meeting Report for ${cleanMeetingId}`,
 694               files: [file]
 695             });
 696             setIsExportingPdf(false);
 697             setAuditNotice('✅ PDF exported and shared successfully!');
 698             setTimeout(() => setAuditNotice(''), 3000);
 699             return;
 700           }
 701         } catch (shareErr) {
 702           if (shareErr.name === 'AbortError') {
 703             setIsExportingPdf(false);
 704             return;
 705           }
 706         }
 707       }
 708 
 709       // Direct file download on web / APK
 710       pdf.save(filename);
 711       setAuditNotice('✅ PDF Report downloaded successfully!');
 712     } catch (err) {
 713       console.warn('jsPDF generation notice, falling back to window.print():', err);
 714       if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
 715         window.print();
 716       }
 717       setAuditNotice('Print dialogue triggered.');
 718     } finally {
 719       if (noPrintElements && noPrintElements.length > 0) {
 720         noPrintElements.forEach((el) => {
 721           if (el && el.style) el.style.display = '';
 722         });
 723       }
 724       setIsExportingPdf(false);
 725       setTimeout(() => setAuditNotice(''), 3500);
 726     }
 727   };
 728 
 729   // Helper to compute overall executive score out of 10 with genuine unbiased weighting
 730   const computeOverallScore = (metrics) => {
 731     if (!metrics) return '5.0';
 732     const skills = Number(metrics.communication_skills) || 5;
 733     const fluency = Number(metrics.fluency) || 5;
 734     const confidence = Number(metrics.confidence) || 5;
 735     const straight = Number(metrics.straightforward_answers) || 5;
 736     const poise = Math.max(1, 11 - (Number(metrics.awkwardness) || 3)); // 1 awk -> 10 poise, 10 awk -> 1 poise
 737     const avg = (skills * 0.25) + (fluency * 0.25) + (confidence * 0.20) + (straight * 0.20) + (poise * 0.10);
 738     return Math.min(10, Math.max(1, Math.round(avg * 10) / 10)).toFixed(1);
 739   };
